description: Source file implementing hardware decode target handling for Windows, including texture allocation, updating, and OpenGL/EGL integration for YUV and RGBA formats.

classes.name: HardwareDecodeTargetPrivate
classes.description: Class managing hardware decode target textures and EGL surfaces for Windows, supporting YUV and RGBA formats.

methods.name: AllocateTexture
methods.description: Allocates a D3D11 texture based on the specified format, width, and height.

methods.name: UpdateTexture
methods.description: Updates the D3D11 texture with data from a video sample.

methods.name: InitTextureYUV
methods.description: Initializes EGL surfaces and OpenGL textures for YUV format.

methods.name: InitTextureRGBA
methods.description: Initializes EGL surfaces and OpenGL textures for RGBA format.

methods.name: HardwareDecodeTargetPrivate
methods.description: Constructor initializing textures and EGL surfaces based on video sample and format.

methods.name: ~HardwareDecodeTargetPrivate
methods.description: Destructor cleaning up EGL surfaces and textures.

methods.name: Update
methods.description: Updates the decode target textures with new video sample data if compatible.
